request: does this app have a readme within the github repo

spec.title: Add README.md documenting the todo app
spec.summary: Create a README.md at the repository root that describes the todo app (Express + SQLite backend with a static HTML/JS frontend), how to set it up and run it, the available REST API endpoints, how to run tests, and the project's file structure. No application code or behavior changes.
acceptance: A README.md file exists at the repository root.
README includes a short description identifying this as a Node.js/Express todo list app with a SQLite database and static frontend.
README documents setup steps: npm ci and npm run seed (or equivalent), matching scripts/setup-app.
README documents how to start the app (npm start / node server.js) and the default URL (http://127.0.0.1:3000), matching scripts/start-app and server.js.
README documents the health check endpoint (GET /health).
README documents the task API endpoints: GET /api/tasks, POST /api/tasks (requires title), PATCH /api/tasks/:id (accepts done boolean), matching the routes in server.js.
README documents how to run tests via npm test (Playwright), referencing tests/baseline.spec.ts and journeys/baseline.journey.ts.
README includes a brief project structure/file overview (server.js, db/, public/, scripts/, tests/, journeys/, harness.yml).
README notes relevant environment variables (PORT, DB_PATH) as used in server.js and db/seed.js.
unchanged: No changes to server.js, public/, db/seed.js, scripts/, tests/, journeys/, playwright configs, harness.yml, or package.json/package-lock.json.
No changes to application runtime behavior, API responses, or database schema.
No LICENSE file or license section is added, since none currently exists in the repo.
No formal CONTRIBUTING guidelines are added.
spec.check: Visually inspect README.md for accuracy against server.js, package.json, harness.yml, and the scripts/ directory; confirm all documented commands and endpoints match the actual code, and confirm no other files were modified.
spec.reviewFocus: Verify the README's setup/run instructions and API documentation are accurate and consistent with server.js, db/seed.js, scripts/setup-app, scripts/start-app, and package.json, and that no other files in the repo were touched.

findings.note: Defines scripts: seed (node db/seed.js), start (node server.js), test (playwright test); engines requires node >=22; dependency express, devDependency @playwright/test.

Express app using node:sqlite DatabaseSync. Serves static public/ dir. Routes: GET /health, GET /api/tasks, POST /api/tasks (title required), PATCH /api/tasks/:id (done boolean). Reads PORT (default 3000) and DB_PATH (default db/tasks.db) from env.
Creates/reseeds tasks table with columns id, title, done; inserts 3 sample rows. Uses DB_PATH env var, defaults to db/tasks.db.
Runs `npm ci` then `npm run seed` for setup.
Runs `node server.js` to start the app.
Defines setup/start/ready/checks/record scripts and artifacts path used by the harness; confirms health endpoint at http://127.0.0.1:3000/health.
Playwright test file; not yet inspected in detail but referenced for testing section of README.
Journey definition file; referenced for project structure section of README.
